Life Drain.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.

Lightning Attunement.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

Lightning Exposure.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.

Lightning Penetration.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

Lockdown.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.

Longshot I.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

Longshot II.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

Maim.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

Malady.d: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.

Mana Bounty.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.

Mobility.d: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.

Momentum.d: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

Multishot I.d: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Multishot II.d: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Murderous Intent.d: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.

Neural Overload.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

Nimble Reload.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

Nova Projectiles I.d: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

Nova Projectiles II.d: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Overabundance I.d: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

Overabundance II.d: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

Overcharge.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

Overextend.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

Overreach.d: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

Payload.d: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

Perfected Endurance.d: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

Perfection.d: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. Pierce I.d: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

Pierce II.d: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

Pierce III.d: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

Pin I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.

Pin II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.

Pin III.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.

Poison I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Poison II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Poison III.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

Poison Spores.d: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which Detonates after a delay, dealing Attack damage. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

Practiced Combo.d: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

Precision I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

Precision II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

Projectile Acceleration I.d: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

Projectile Acceleration II.d: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

Projectile Acceleration III.d: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

Projectile Deceleration I.d: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Projectile Deceleration II.d: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Punch Through.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

Pursuit I.d: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Pursuit II.d: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Pursuit III.d: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Rakiata's Flow.d: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

Rapid Attacks I.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

Rapid Attacks II.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

Rapid Attacks III.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

Ratha's Assault.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

Rearm I.d: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Rearm II.d: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Retreat I.d: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Retreat II.d: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Retreat III.d: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Ricochet I.d: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Ricochet II.d: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Rigwald's Ferocity.d: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Salvo.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Second Wind I.d: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Second Wind II.d: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Second Wind III.d: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Shock.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

Shocking Leap.d: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

Slow Potency.d: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

Soul Drain.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

Spectral Volley.d: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

Stormchain.d: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

Streamlined Rounds.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

Swift Affliction I.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

Swift Affliction II.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

Swift Affliction III.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

Tacati's Ire.d: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

Tasalio's Rhythm.d: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

Tul's Stillness.d: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

Unerring Power.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

Untouchable.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Volt.d: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

Warm Blooded.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Wind Wave.d: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

Window of Opportunity I.d: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

Window of Opportunity II.d: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

Abiding Hex.d: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

Accelerated Growth II.d: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

Accelerated Growth.d: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

Acrimony.d: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Advancing Storm.d: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

Ahn's Citadel.d: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

Ambrosia II.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Ambrosia.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Ambush.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.

Arbiter's Ignition.d: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

Arcane Surge.d: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

Astral Projection.d: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

Atziri's Allure.d: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

Atziri's Communion.d: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.

Bhatair's Vengeance.d: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

Bidding I.d: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Bidding II.d: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Bidding III.d: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Biting Frost I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Biting Frost II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Blazing Critical.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

Bone Shrapnel.d: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

Bone Shrapnel Explosion.d: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the maximum Life of the Pinned target slain.

Boundless Energy I.d: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Boundless Energy II.d: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Brittle Armour.d: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

Burgeon I.d: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Burgeon II.d: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Burning Inscription.d: Create Ignited Ground Igniting Enemies based on a percentage of your Maximum Mana.

Catalysing Elements.d: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

Catalysing Discharge.d: Triggered when supported skill is boosted by an Elemental Ground Surface to deal damage of the matching Element.

Catharsis.d: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

Chaos Attunement.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

Chaos Mastery.d: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Chaotic Freeze.d: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Clarity I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Clarity II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Cold Attunement.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

Cold Exposure.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it inflicts Freeze.

Cold Mastery.d: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Cold Penetration.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

Controlled Destruction.d: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

Corpse Conservation.d: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

Coursing Current.d: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

Crackling Barrier.d: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

Crazed Minions.d: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

Creeping Chill.d: Creates spreading Chilled Ground around Ice Crystals created by Supported Skills.

Crescendo I.d: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

Crescendo II.d: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

Crescendo III.d: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

Deep Freeze.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.

Dark Consequences.d: Explodes a Witchtoad to deal spell damage in an area.

Doedre's Dark Design.d: Explodes and deals Chaos Damage when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported Curse on Hit.

Drain Ailments.d: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

Electromagnetism.d: Pull enemies in and pulse Lightning damage, Hindering enemies Hit. Each pulse increases in damage, with the final pulse dealing additional damage.

Elemental Army.d: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Elemental Discharge.d: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions or skills which already Consume Elemental Ailments.

Elemental Focus.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

Embitter.d: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

Encroaching Ground.d: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

Energy Capacitor.d: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

Enervating Nova.d: Unleash a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies Hit can be Electrocuted by all Lightning damage for a short duration.

Esh's Radiance.d: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

Essence Harvest.d: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

Eternal Mark.d: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

Expanse.d: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Extraction.d: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

Feeding Frenzy I.d: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Fiery Death.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.

Fire Mastery.d: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Fluke.d: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Focused Curse.d: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

Font of Mana.d: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.

Fortress I.d: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.

Fortress II.d: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.

Freeze.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

Frost Nexus.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

Glacier.d: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

Harmonic Remnants II.d: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

Gambleshot.d: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

Gorge.d: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.

When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

Hayoxi's Fulmination.d: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

Heightened Curse.d: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.

Hex Bloom.d: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

Hourglass.d: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Hulking Minions.d: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

Ice Bite II.d: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

Icicle.d: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

Impending Doom.d: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

Doom Blast.d: Deal Chaos damage in an area around the previously Cursed enemy.

Inexorable Critical II.d: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

Kalisa's Crescendo.d: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

Kurgal's Leash.d: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

Last Gasp.d: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.

Lightning Mastery.d: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Living Lightning II.d: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Loyalty.d: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

Magnetic Remnants.d: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Magnified Area I.d: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

Magnified Area II.d: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

Mark of Siphoning.d: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

Minion Pact II.d: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

Muster.d: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.
