Mysticism II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Oisin's Oath.d: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.

Perpetual Charge.d: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

Physical Mastery.d: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Pinpoint Critical.d: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

Potent Exposure.d: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

Practical Magic I.d: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

Practical Magic II.d: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

Profanity I.d: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

Profanity II.d: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

Rapid Casting I.d: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Rapid Casting II.d: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Rapid Casting III.d: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

Rising Tempest.d: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

Ritualistic Curse.d: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

Romira's Requital.d: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

Sacrificial Lamb I.d: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.

Sacrificial Lamb II.d: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

Sacrificial Offering.d: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

Shock Conduction.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

Shock Conduction II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

Shock Siphon.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

Sione's Temper.d: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

Spell Cascade.d: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

Spell Echo.d: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

Static Shocks.d: Attaches a Static Shock to a target that pulses Lightning damage to the attached target and nearby enemies. Targets can have a maximum of one Static Shock attached to them.

Stormfire.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

Strong Hearted.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Supercritical.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

Tecrod's Revenge.d: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

Thrill of the Kill.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

Thrill of the Kill II.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

Upwelling I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Upwelling II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Varashta's Blessing.d: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Verglas.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

Vilenta's Propulsion.d: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

Volatility.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

Wildfire.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

Wildshards I.d: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Wildshards II.d: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Withering Touch.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

Xibaqua's Rending.d: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Fiery Reclamation.d: Deals Fire damage in an area around the exploding Corpse based on its maximum Life.

Zarokh's Refrain.d: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

Zarokh's Revolt.d: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

Zenith I.d: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Zenith II.d: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Aftershock I.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

Aftershock II.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

Amanamu's Tithe.d: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

Ancestral Aid.d: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

Ancestral Call I.d: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Ancestral Call II.d: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Armour Break I.d: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

Armour Break II.d: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

Armour Break III.d: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

Armour Demolisher I.d: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

Armour Demolisher II.d: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

Arms Length.d: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

Atalui's Bloodletting.d: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

Auto Reload.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Barbs I.d: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Battershout.d: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the Broken Armour of the target which this explosion was Triggered from.

Behead I.d: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

Behead II.d: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

Bleed I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Bleed II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Bleed III.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

Bleed IV.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

Bloodlust.d: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

Brambleslam.d: Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

Brambles.d: Creates Hazardous Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are Maimed. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time.

Branching Fissures I.d: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Branching Fissures II.d: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Brink I.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

Brink II.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

Brutality I.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Brutality II.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Brutality III.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

Brutus' Brain.d: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Cannibalism I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

Cannibalism II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

Cirel's Cultivation.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Clash.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

Compressed Duration I.d: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

Compressed Duration II.d: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

Concoct I.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Concoct II.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Cool Headed.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Corrupting Cry I.d: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

Corrupted Cry.d: Covers the target in Corrupted Blood which damages them.

Corrupting Cry II.d: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

Crater.d: Creates multiple Fissures when landing with Supported Skill.

Daresso's Passion.d: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

Dauntless.d: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

Deadly Resolve.d: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.

Deep Cuts I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

Deep Cuts II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

Defy I.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

Defy II.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

Direstrike I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Direstrike II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Double Barrel I.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

Double Barrel II.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

Double Barrel III.d: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Echoing Cry.d: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

Efficiency I.d: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

Efficiency II.d: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

Einhar's Beastrite.d: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Elemental Armament I.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

Elemental Armament II.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

Elemental Armament III.d: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

Enduring Impact I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Enduring Impact II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Enraged Warcry I.d: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Enraged Warcry II.d: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Eternal Flame I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

Eternal Flame II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

Eternal Flame III.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

Execute I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Execute II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Execute III.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

Exploit Weakness.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Exposing Cry.d: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

Fan The Flames.d: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

Fan the Flames.d: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon

Fan The Flames II.d: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

Fire Attunement.d: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

Fire Exposure.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.

Fire Penetration I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

Fire Penetration II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

Fist of War I.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

Fist of War II.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

Fist of War III.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.

Flame Pillar.d: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

Flamepierce.d: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

Font of Blood.d: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.

Fresh Clip I.d: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

Fresh Clip II.d: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

Haemocrystals.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

Hardy Totems I.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Hardy Totems II.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Heavy Swing.d: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

Heft.d: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

Helbrym's Hide.d: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.

Herbalism I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

Herbalism II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

Holy Descent.d: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

Ignite I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

Ignite II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

Ignite III.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

Immolate.d: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

Impact Shockwave.d: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Incision.d: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

Infernal Legion I.d: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Infernal Legion II.d: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Infernal Legion III.d: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Jagged Ground I.d: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

Jagged Ground II.d: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

Kaom's Madness.d: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

Knockback.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

Lasting Ground.d: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

Life Leech I.d: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

Life Leech II.d: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

Life Leech III.d: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

Lifetap.d: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

Long Fuse I.d: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Long Fuse II.d: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Mark for Death.d: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Mark for Death II.d: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Meat Shield I.d: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Meat Shield II.d: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

Minion Splash I.d: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

Minion Splash II.d: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

Opening Move.d: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

Paquate's Pact.d: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.

Twisted Pact.d: Covers the target in large quantities of Corrupted Blood which severely damages them.

Persistent Ground I.d: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

Persistent Ground II.d: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

Persistent Ground III.d: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

Prolonged Duration I.d: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

Prolonged Duration II.d: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

Quill Burst.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

Rage I.d: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Rage II.d: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Rage III.d: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

Rageforged I.d: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Rageforged II.d: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Raging Cry.d: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

Refraction I.d: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Refraction II.d: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Refraction III.d: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

Reinforced Totems I.d: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Reinforced Totems II.d: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Relentless Rage.d: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.

Remnant Potency I.d: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

Remnant Potency II.d: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Remnant Potency III.d: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Rending Apex.d: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

Retaliate I.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Retaliate II.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Reverberate.d: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

Rip.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

Rupture.d: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

Rusted Spikes.d: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

Ruthless.d: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

Searing Flame I.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Searing Flame II.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Selfless Remnants.d: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

Short Fuse I.d: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

Short Fuse II.d: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

Skittering Stone I.d: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Skittering Stone.d: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.

Skittering Stone II.d: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Spar.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Splinter Totem I.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Splinter Totem II.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Steadfast I.d: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

Steadfast II.d: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

Stoicism I.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Stoicism II.d: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Stomping Ground.d: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

Stun I.d: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

Stun II.d: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

Stun III.d: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

Syzygy.d: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

Tawhoa's Tending.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

Tawhoa's Vengeance.d: Deals Physical Damage in an area, based on Totem Life.

Tear.d: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

Tectonic Slams.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

Thornskin I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Thornskin II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Tireless.d: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

Uhtred's Augury.d: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Uhtred's Exodus.d: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Uhtred's Omen.d: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Undermine.d: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

Upheaval I.d: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

Upheaval II.d: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

Urgent Totems I.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Urgent Totems II.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Urgent Totems III.d: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

Uruk's Smelting.d: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

Uul-Netol's Embrace.d: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

Vanguard I.d: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Vanguard II.d: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Vitality I.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Vitality II.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Vruun's Inevitability.d: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Xoph's Pyre.d: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

Zerphi's Infamy.d: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly  increased area of effect.

Abyssal Apparition.d: Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.

Acidic Concoction.d: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Align Fate.d: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.

Ancestral Spirits.d: This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.

Animus Exchange.d: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.

Animus Splinters.d: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.

Apocalypse.d: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.

Hailstorm.d: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a series of icy hailstones to rain down in an area over a duration.

Meteor.d: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing Fire damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.

Crash Lightning.d: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing Lightning damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final Lightning strike.

Arbiter's Reach.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you periodically grant Guard to allies in your Presence while the Skill is active.

Archon of Chayula.d: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.

Chayula's Will.d: Conjure a Chaos tornado that chases down and Slows enemies.

Azmerian Swarms.d: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and inflict Faerie Fire on Hit.

Azmerian Wolf.d: Summons an ancient Reviving Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on Command. It Maims when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict Bleeding, or howl to inspire nearby allies.

Bitter Dead.d: Spend Ward and target an area, transforming Corpses into bitter cores that seek out enemies and Chill enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional Cold damage over time.

Bleeding Concoction.d: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Blood Boil.d: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.

Bow Shot.d: Fire an arrow with your Bow.

Breachlord's Amalgam.d: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.

Breachlord's Rift.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Break Armour of enemies it Freezes or Electrocutes.

Bursting Fen Toad.d: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, the toad then explodes, dealing Attack damage in an area and inflicting Poison.  Damage you deal with this skill is not based on your Weapon.

Called Shots.d: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.

Cast on Charm Use.d: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Catha's Brilliance.d: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Chaotic Surge.d: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Conductive Runes.d: Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage that is not based on your Weapon's damage and apply Electrocution buildup.

Crossbow Shot.d: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.

Basic Bolt.d: Clear your active Bolt and reload any ammunition.

Crushing Fear.d: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Concussive Runes.d: Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.

Demon Form.d: Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.

Detonate Living.d: Spend Runic Ward to cause a destabilising Hit against an enemy under the Culling Strike Threshold, making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the Culling Strike Threshold.

Elemental Expression.d: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.

Elemental Storm.d: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.

Elemental Surge.d: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Encase in Jade.d: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.

Esh's Prowess.d: Supports Lightning Skills that Hit, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not Support Skills which do not have levels.

Eternal March.d: Spend Runic Ward to instantly Revive your Minions. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.

Explosive Concoction.d: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Explosive Transmutation.d: While active, picking up Remnants Triggers a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the Remnant based on the type of Remnant picked up.

Fire Spell on Melee Hit.d: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Fist Of Kalguur.d: Supports Slams you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of Runic Ward to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted Slams are Empowered with extra Physical damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an Aftershock after a duration. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

Fragments of the Past.d: Spend Runic Ward to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and Triggers Ice Fragments.

Frostflame Nova.d: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto Ignited enemies, refreshing the duration of their active Ignite and rapidly Freezing them but preventing them from being Ignited further until the Ignite expires.

Fulminating Concoction.d: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Future-Past.d: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.

Gelid Palm.d: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.

Grenade.d: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.

Grim Pillars.d: Spend Runic Ward to cause damaging Ice-Crystal spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of Cold damage.

Harbinger of Madness.d: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

Herald of the Royal Queen.d: Killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon Damage, but is based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic.

Her Declaration.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing enemies that enter your Presence to become Intimidated while the Skill is active.

Healing Runes.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to lose Runic Ward and heal nearby allies based on the Ward lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.

Hollow Focus.d: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.

Hollow Form.d: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.

Hollow Resonance.d: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.

Hollow Shell.d: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.

Inevitable Agony.d: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.

Into the Breach.d: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.

Kelari's Malediction.d: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.

Kelari, the Tainted Sands.d: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.

Leylines.d: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

Life Remnants.d: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.

Manifest Weapon.d: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.

Maul.d: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.

Meditate.d: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.

Medved's Felling.d: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.

Midnight Zenith.d: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.

Mirage Deadeye.d: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

Mist Raven.d: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be Commanded to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a Frenzy Charge for each enemy it Culls.

Molten Shower.d: Fires molten Projectiles from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing Attack damage in an area.

Moment of Vulnerability.d: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.

Morrigan's Insight.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Navira, the Last Mirage.d: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.

Olroth's Conviction.d: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

Olroth's Hubris.d: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical and Cold damage based on their Runic Ward cost, in addition to causing Physical damage to Contribute to Freeze buildup. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

Parry.d: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

Pinnacle of Power.d: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.

Powered by Verisium.d: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.

Primal Bounty.d: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.

Prototype Seventeen.d: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.

Rain of Blades.d: Pour your Runic Ward into conjuring blades. For the duration of the Buff, these blades fall on enemies Hit by your Projectile Attacks.

Raise Shield.d: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

Refutation.d: Spends all your Runic Ward to gain a short-duration Buff that causes you to Block all Blockable Hits and apply Parried to enemies from which you've Blocked a Hit. This Buff is removed if you are Heavy Stunned. While this Buff is active, you cannot be Light Stunned, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.

Remnants of Kalguur.d: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.

Rend.d: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.

Repulsion.d: Spend Runic Ward to Curse enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. Hitting these enemies removes the Curse to Trigger an explosion, Knocking Back nearby enemies and causing more Stun buildup based on the Fragility on the target Hit.

Repulsion Wave.d: Deals Physical Attack damage in an area around the Cursed target that is not based on your Weapon's damage. Other targets are Knocked back and take more Stun buildup based on the Fragility they have.

Righteous Descent.d: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a Fragment of Divinity near you or the targeted location, this attack will Consume it when you leap to become Empowered, dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.

Rite of Restoration.d: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Buff to you and Allies standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Ritual Sacrifice.d: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration, or gain a single random Modifier at the cost of your own life force.

Runeforged Blades.d: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Runic Extraction.d: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.

Runic Infusion.d: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

Runic Reprieve.d: Channel to create a protective bubble all around you, Blocking Hits against you. While Channelling this Skill, you cannot be Light Stunned by Hits you Block, and damage you take from Hits is also removed from Runic Ward. Blocking Hits this way causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot recover Runic Ward while this Skill is active.

Runic Tempering.d: Channel to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are Hit while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your Thorns damage in an area around your attacker.

Ruzhan, the Blazing Sword.d: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.

Sanguine Revelry.d: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful Remnant, and Hitting a Bleeding target spawns a Hateful Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful Remnant grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.

Scouring Flame.d: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

Seraph's Heart.d: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

Shattering Concoction.d: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Cold Attack damage in an area and inflicting Exposure. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Shred.d: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.

Skyfall.d: Build Glory by spending Runic Ward. When you have maximum Glory, you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a Temporary Minion. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Verisium Infusion, if possible, to increase the number of Minions summoned.

Smash to Smithereens.d: Blows strong enough to Heavy Stun an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily Break Armour.

Soaring Midnight.d: Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.

Embrace The Fall.d: Teleport to your thrown Shield, appearing in the air and Slamming it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an Ice Crystal with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.

Sorcery Ward.d: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.

Spear Throw.d: Hurl your Spear with force. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to cause the Spear to explode at the end of its flight.

Spirit Vessel.d: Summons a Shapeshifting Spirit Vessel Companion that uses copies of socketed Bear, Werewolf, and Wyvern Skills.

Starborn Onslaught.d: Build up Glory by Freezing or Chilling enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may jump backwards loosing your Mace with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases Fissures and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.

Styrn's Ferocity.d: Supports Shield Skills that Hit, causing those Hits to Crush their targets, and Physical Hits against those targets while Crushed to Break their Armour.

Styrn's Mountain.d: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

Summon Infernal Hound.d: Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.

Supporting Fire.d: Recruit artillery Minions that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your Command, then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.

Tangmazu's Thurible.d: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.

Temper Weapon.d: Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.

Temporal Rift.d: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.

The Stars Answer.d: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly Triggering Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.

Starfall.d: A star falls at a targeted location, dealing area damage on impact. Larger stars leave Chilled Ground for a short duration.

Time Freeze.d: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.

Time Snap.d: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.

Trickster's Shard.d: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.

Fragment Self.d: Creates a Fractured Mimic of yourself, suspended in time at the point of casting the Triggering Spell. If you reach the Limit of Fractured Mimics, they will all finish casting their Spells and disappear.

Triskelion Cascade.d: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.

Tul's Avalanche.d: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Unbound Avatar.d: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

Uhtred's Constellation.d: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

Uhtred's Rite.d: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

Virtuous Barrier.d: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each Attribute type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are Hit.

Verisium Manifestations.d: While active, Hitting with an Attack will spend Runic Ward to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived Temporary Minion that rapidly Attacks nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

Manifest Rune.d: Summon a short-lived Verisium Manifestation that launches Projectile Attacks at enemies.

Vivid Stampede.d: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind Shocked Ground.

Voltaic Barrier.d: Spend Runic Ward to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and Electrocuting enemies caught between them. Projectiles you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on Hit as Chaining Lightning beams.

Vorana's Siege.d: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.

Vruun's Aftermath.d: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

Wardbound Minions.d: Spend all your Runic Ward to summon Temporary Wardbound Casters. These Minions target nearby enemies with damaging Cold Spells.

Wild Protector.d: Call upon a Bear Spirit Companion to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to Maim them, Leeches Life with its slam, and periodically roars to Intimidate enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your Companion limit.

Wildwood's Gifts.d: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.

Bonebreaker.d: A Strike that causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

Shattering Roar.d: Command a Skeletal Brute to use a Warcry, Intimidating nearby enemies and Consuming Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

Death Storm.d: Lightning bolts strike all fallen Skeletons in the area, creating Shocked Ground around them.

Ice Armour.d: Command a Skeletal Frost Mage to target a location or Minion and apply Ice Armour to Minions in an area, reducing damage taken from Hits, causing damage to enemies that Hit them, and counting as Frozen for other effects.

Fire Bomb.d: Attacks with a bouncing bomb that explodes on hit.

Explosive Demise.d: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.

Enrage.d: Enrage all Skeletal Reavers, causing them to lose life over time and gain Rage on hit.

Zap.d: Teleport to a target, dealing Lightning Attack Damage.

Death From Above.d: Fires a flare at a target location, attaching to an enemy if it lands on one, then launches a series of arrow volleys centred around the flare.

Navira's Embrace.d: Command Navira to create a bubble shield which absorbs a portion of the damage dealt by enemies standing outside the shield. The maximum amount of damage that can be absorbed is based on your maximum Mana. If the shield is destroyed by damage, it collapses into a patch of Chilled Ground.

Navira's Fracturing.d: Command Navira to fracture all nearby areas of Chilled Ground that have enemies standing on them, doing high Spell damage with extreme Freeze potential.

Navira's Well.d: Command Navira to bolster your Energy Shield, causing it to begin Recharging immediately and granting you increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate for a duration.

Navira's Oasis.d: Command Navira to turn nearby Chilled Ground into Navira's Oasis, a mirage which grants you and Allies standing in it Flask charges and damage Recouped as Life and Mana. Plants in the area become Overgrown.

Navira's Calming.d: When you Command Navira to use a Skill, she also emits a restorative wave that grants you and any other Allies it touches increased Mana Regeneration for a short duration.

Ruzhan's Brand.d: Command Ruzhan to place a fiery brand on an enemy. After a delay or when Detonated, the brand explodes, dealing Spell damage to enemies caught in the blast.

Ruzhan's Trap.d: Command Ruzhan to hurl his greatsword, spreading hazardous runes on the ground where it lands. If an enemy steps on a rune, it erupts in a fiery tornado that deals Spell damage.

Ruzhan's Reckoning.d: Command Ruzhan to teleport to the target location. Upon arrival, the Djinn deals Spell damage to enemies around him then slams his blazing sword into the ground, creating a wave of lava that also deals Spell damage.

Ruzhan's Fury.d: Command Ruzhan to conjure two volleys of flaming embers and fire them forward. The embers explode on impact, dealing Spell damage.

Ruzhan's Zealotry.d: When you use a damaging Skill, Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies near your target with zealous fervour, inflicting Exposure.

Kelari's Brutality.d: Command Kelari to throw a volley of knives at the target location. The knives burrow into the ground, then erupt into the air after a short delay, dealing Spell damage.

Kelari's Deception.d: Command Kelari to create a blast at the target location that deals Spell damage, and leave behind a clone that persists for a short duration. This skill can store multiple charges, and using it again while a clone from a previous use is still alive causes that clone to explode, dealing even more damage.

Kelari's Judgment.d: Channel and Command Kelari to Channel alongside you, creating blades that hang over the target location. The longer you Channel, the more blades Kelari will create. Upon release, his blades plunge into the ground and create shockwaves that deal Spell damage.

Winged Entropy.d: The Flock damages enemies around you.

Mad Flight.d: Command part of your flock to leave and crash through a set of illusory mirrors, Attacking enemies in the area between the mirrors with frequent Hits.

Eternal Hunt.d: The Azmerian Wolf howls, reaching out to the spirits to begin an Eternal Hunt. While the Eternal Hunt persists, spirits manifest as spectral wolves to ambush foes, damaging and Maiming enemies they Hit before disappearing.
